update_md5_fa8e476e3294985c72f70e3b68c98.content_md5_fa8e476e3294985c72f70e3b68c9:
### Ignore files
Optionally create `.grok/ragignore` (one rule per line). In v1, rules are simple **substring matches** against relative paths.
### RAG DB persistence (Node/Bun)
`@sqliteai/sqlite-wasm` runs SQLite in WebAssembly and does not mount a native Node filesystem VFS by default. To keep `.grok/rag.db` persistent across runs, Grok CLI:
- Opens an in-memory DB - Deserializes from `.grok/rag.db` if it exists - Exports the DB back to `.grok/rag.db` on `VectorDb.close()` when mutated
Avoid concurrent writers (two processes opening the same project RAG DB at once) because the last writer wins.

## RAG and k-medoids
- **Enable RAG**: Set `rag.enabled: true` in project `.grok/settings.json` (or via `/config`), then run `grok rag index`. - **Behavior**: Retriever embeds the user query, searches `.grok/rag.db`, and injects chunks into the system message for that turn. - **k-medoids (optional)**: When `project.rag.useKMedoids` is true, the retriever fetches `rag.candidateCount` candidates and uses k-medoids to pick `rag.topK` representative chunks (better diversity). Enable via `/config` (RAG → Use k-medoids) or `grok config set project.rag.useKMedoids true`; all RAG keys in `docs/settings.json.md`.

## RAG and k-medoids
- **Enable RAG**: Set `rag.enabled: true` in project `.grok/settings.json` (or via `/config`), then run `grok rag index`. - **Behavior**: Retriever embeds the user query, searches `.grok/rag.db`, and injects chunks into the system message for that turn. - **Persistence note (Node/Bun)**: `@sqliteai/sqlite-wasm` is WASM and does not mount a native Node FS VFS by default. This repo persists `.grok/rag.db` by deserializing from disk on open and exporting back to disk on `VectorDb.close()` when mutated (see `src/rag/vector-db.ts`). - **k-medoids (optional)**: When `project.rag.useKMedoids` is true, the retriever fetches `rag.candidateCount` candidates and uses k-medoids to pick `rag.topK` representative chunks (better diversity). Enable via `/config` (RAG → Use k-medoids) or `grok config set project.rag.useKMedoids true`; all RAG keys in `docs/settings.json.md`.
RAG GUI (MakerAI):
- Build `RagManager.exe`: `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-makerai.ps1` - Launch interactive editor: `grok rag gui` - Smoke test (no UI): `grok rag gui --smoke` (writes `.grok/makerai-ragvector.smoke.json`)
